title: FedEx Earns IATA CEIV Pharma Certification for Its Incheon Gateway in Korea
summary: Marks 30 CEIV Pharma certified facilities worldwide, reinforcing its commitment in pharmaceutical air transport and handling
body_markdown:
**SEOUL, South Korea, September 2, 2026** — Federal Express Corporation (FedEx), one of the world’s largest express transportation companies, announced that its FedEx Incheon Gateway at Incheon International Airport has achieved the International Air Transport Association (IATA) Center of Excellence for Independent Validators (CEIV) Pharma certification. This milestone brings FedEx’s total number of CEIV Pharma certifications across its global air hubs and cargo handling facilities to 30, reinforcing the company’s commitment to precision, quality, and excellence in transporting critical, temperature-sensitive shipments for the healthcare industry.
The IATA CEIV Pharma certification is a globally recognized standard for service excellence in the air transportation of pharmaceutical products. It ensures the safety, security, compliance, and efficiency of handling and transporting time- and temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals, such as biologics and clinical trials. The certification is awarded following a rigorous assessment of more than 280 criteria, covering pharmaceutical handling procedures, storage facilities, and equipment management practices.


FedEx Incheon Gateway is exceptionally equipped to handle temperature-sensitive healthcare shipments. Spanning more than 23,000 square meters, the facility features a 120-square-meter temperature-controlled storage area with a 24/7 real-time monitoring system, alongside three dedicated chambers compliant with Good Distribution Practice to meet freezer, chiller, and controlled ambient requirements.


Korea is rapidly establishing itself as a global leader in clinical trials and the biopharmaceutical industry, fueling strong demand for specialized cold‑chain logistics that safeguard the quality and integrity of life‑saving healthcare products. According to the Korea National Enterprise for Clinical Trials (KoNECT), Korea ranks among the world’s top 10 countries for clinical trial activity and is second in Asia for multinational clinical trials.\[1\]


“Achieving CEIV Pharma certification underscores our capability to deliver healthcare logistics services that meet the highest international standards,” said Wonbin Park, managing director of FedEx Korea. “We remain committed to providing safe, reliable end-to-end solutions that connect patients worldwide and empower the advancement of healthcare innovation.”


Customers in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector need closed loop temperature-controlled services to preserve temperature integrity to ensure product efficacy. With decades of experience, FedEx provides expertise in customized solutions for clinical trial solutions, biologics and vaccines enabled by its robust International Express network, customized Time Critical Special Services (SpS), and a global network of Life Science Centers in Gimpo (Korea), Singapore, Tokyo (Japan), Mumbai (India), Memphis (United States), and Veldhoven (the Netherlands). The company’s extensive healthcare infrastructure also includes more than 130 cold-chain facilities worldwide, ensuring continuous temperature integrity for shipments moving through our domestic and international networks.


\[1\]Korea National Enterprise for Clinical Trials (KoNECT), “Why Korea,” National Clinical Trial Hub Platform[https://khub.konect.or.kr/whykorea/whykorea?utm_](https://khub.konect.or.kr/whykorea/whykorea?utm_)
